title: Alarm dialog gone after minimizing and maximizing the app
symptom: After a bolus delivery issue, an alarm triggered with audio and a dialog offering mute/snooze options. Pressing the home button minimized the app; after maximizing, the audio continued but the dialog was gone, so the alarm could not be stopped without rebooting the device.
evidence_quote: After maximizing the application the audio was still there but the alarm dialog was gone. So I couldn't stop the alarm. I had to reboot the device to get rid of it.
